# Data Source: identitynow_org_config

Use this data source to read the tenant-wide organization configuration, e.g. the time zone. To change the settings use the [identitynow_org_config](../resources/org_config) resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "identitynow_org_config" "current" {}

output "org_time_zone" {
  value = data.identitynow_org_config.current.time_zone
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `arm_auth` (String, Sensitive) ARM authentication string. The value is sensitive.
- `arm_customer_id` (String) Access Risk Management (ARM) customer ID.
- `arm_db` (String) ARM database name.
- `arm_sap_system_id_mappings` (String) ARM mappings of IdentityNow source IDs to ARM system IDs, as returned by the API.
- `arm_sso_url` (String) ARM SSO URL.
- `iai_enable_certification_recommendations` (Boolean) Whether AI certification recommendations are enabled.
- `id` (String) Always `org-config`.
- `lcs_change_honors_source_enable_feature` (Boolean) Whether the LCS_CHANGE_HONORS_SOURCE_ENABLE_FEATURE flag is enabled.
- `org_name` (String) Name of the org.
- `sod_report_configs_json` (String) Separation of duties report columns, objects with `columnName`, `required`, `included` and `order`. Required columns cannot be changed. A JSON array.
- `time_zone` (String) Time zone of the org, e.g. `Europe/Warsaw`. It determines when scheduled tasks run. Valid values are returned by the `identitynow_valid_time_zones` data source.
